# PR #157 repair correctness review

## A) Verdict

**BLOCK** at `eb37f6a4aa586205da2711b0fc297c0efdf4759b`.

**F001 and F003 closed. F002 partially open:** non-executed Delivers checks count as parser proof. **F004, new:** realpath lookup errors still permit silent CLI exit 0.

## B) Scope and proof

Reviewed `0eb47a422d07903c065edf72b59d4876d2d256d4..eb37f6a4aa586205da2711b0fc297c0efdf4759b`, principally 6c01d4ba and its main merge. Previously reviewed main imports are separate.

Clean pinned checkout; GitHub and ls-remote agree, CLEAN. Latest checks passed, including the successful delivers run after the cancelled predecessor. CI `42391070697`, attempt 1, is at this exact head. Both Node jobs ran all 21 pr-freeze tests; each reports 2,225 Vitest cases passed and six skipped. Typecheck/lint succeeded.

The two counterexamples below are source-derived, not locally reproduced. No local builds/tests, script runs, dependency setup, fetches or worktree mutations were performed. The guard mutations are author-reported, not reviewer runs.

## C) F002, P2: SKIPPED/NEUTRAL is not Delivers parser proof

`harness/scripts/pr-freeze.ts:186` collapses SUCCESS, NEUTRAL and SKIPPED into `pass`. The new parser-absent fallback (`:402-409`) checks only that collapsed state, so it calls a skipped or neutral Delivers check "passed on this head".

Concrete supported-input path: keep the healthy fake world's head/base/CLEAN/ready/migration/other checks; omit the parser; supply a completed latest delivers check with conclusion SKIPPED and a malformed Delivers body. checkState returns pass, both checks and delivers conditions succeed, report.final becomes true, render prints FINAL and main returns 0. NEUTRAL follows the same path. GitHub accepting a skipped check for merge is not evidence that CI's parser parsed this body.

The new absent/failing/queued/passing controls are correct but omit non-execution conclusions. Preserve the latest selected result's strict parser-success evidence, rather than reusing generic merge-acceptable state. Add skipped/neutral Delivers negatives with a real SUCCESS positive. No new parser is needed.

## D) F004, P2: entrypoint lookup errors are swallowed outside main

`isMain` catches every fileURL/realpath failure and returns false (`pr-freeze.ts:520-525`). The top-level guard then never calls main or process.exit (`:530-531`), and an otherwise normal CLI process falls through with no diagnostic and exit 0.

This affects a CLI already loaded by Node if an entry/module path becomes unavailable or a filesystem lookup fails before the guard, for example when the source/entry link disappears between load and realpath. The exception is not proof that the module was imported as a library. It also bypasses main's diagnostic/exit-2 catch.

The healthy-symlink test now proves that particular launch prints usage and exits 2. It does not cover entrypoint lookup failure. Separate a proven non-main comparison from lookup failure; fail the latter visibly instead of success-shaped fallthrough, with a CLI fault control requiring a diagnostic and nonzero tool-failure exit.

## E) F001 and F003 closed

Latest check selection now ignores start timestamps and orders same-workflow/name runs by Actions job id. Absent/null/empty/zero start cases, queued/in-progress runs, newer successful re-run, separate workflows with identical names, unordered runs and superseded failure are covered. Ambiguous multiple runs without job ordering do not pass.

Worktree reporting/reuse requires the expected name, exact full head, detached marker and empty porcelain status. Branch-attached, dirty and wrong-head controls refuse reuse/creation; the tool never moves an existing checkout automatically. Worktree presence remains informational to PR finality, as specified.

## F) Other paths and cost

Head disagreement, missing head, non-main, non-CLEAN, draft, empty checks and failing latest checks remain explicit failures. The added-migration guard checks numbering above main and the matching top SCHEMA_VERSION. Built-parser body failure remains NOT FINAL.

The new URL processing is parsing, not execution. Commands still use argv/stdin, with raw SHA fetches into FETCH_HEAD and no constructed shell command. Per-matching-worktree status reads add finite local work to this manual invocation; there is no new recurring loop. Security and performance retain their independent verdict scopes.

## G) Handover

Keep the repaired ordering/worktree/symlink-positive controls. Fix strict Delivers proof and visible entrypoint-error handling, then freeze one new head with the focused negatives in CI. Harness observation DL-008 records both missing guards. No product code was changed by this reviewer.
